text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm Dantsu Flame. I look forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me is so amazing, you 
know~? To be honest, I'm feeling a bit 
insecure... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
But... even so, I want to win! To stand in 
the center of the stage... as the "lead 
role"!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
